camera.reason: 50MP f/1.8 main camera is decent in daylight, with no OIS and only an auxiliary second lens.

performance.reason: Snapdragon 685 is smooth in daily use and handles light gaming.

battery.reason: 7,000mAh silicon-carbon battery with 33W charging lasts well past a full day.

display.reason: 6.9 inch FHD+ LCD at 144Hz, sharp and smooth but only 850 nits peak.

build.reason: Plastic body with IP64 dust and splash resistance.

software.reason: Reported 2 Android upgrades and 4 years of security patches.

value.reason: Biggest battery and only FHD+ 144Hz screen among the cheaper phones here.

availability.reason: In stock at PriceOye and Shophive with official Xiaomi warranty.

notes: Pakistan model is the 4G Snapdragon 685 version (WhatMobile wrongly lists Snapdragon 6s Gen 3). WhatMobile lists 58,999 and Shophive sells it at 58,999 in stock. The 2 OS updates and 4 years of patches come from a fan site, not an official Xiaomi page.
